findings.name: ownership
findings.question: Can I credit all of Lobby’s media and access infrastructure to Mahmoud individually? Explain the documented personal scope and collaborative ownership, including any attribution limits.
findings.answer:
PORTFOLIO AI
Scope & Ownership

No, you cannot credit all of Lobby’s media and access infrastructure to Mahmoud individually.

Lobby is a collaborative team project delivered by a six-person team. Feature descriptions describe total team delivery rather than individual ownership.

Documented Personal Scope

Mahmoud’s documented personal contributions are limited to:

Collaborating on persistent community and temporary guest-room workflows in a TypeScript monorepo.
Contributing to authenticated and guest access, invitation links, validation, and Supabase-backed services.
Attribution Limits
Engineering Decisions: Code-inspected architecture decisions (such as Zod schema validation and LiveKit media grant minting) describe overall project implementation; personal authorship of these specific mechanisms is not established by code inspection.
Media & Call Features: LiveKit media paths, audio/screen sharing, and live chat represent team implementation. Individual ownership is strictly bounded by his documented contribution record.

findings.name: cedar-retry
findings.question: Explain Cedar’s accounting and advisor implementation. Which parts are deterministic and which involve an AI provider? What does the review actually verify?
findings.answer:
PORTFOLIO AI
Cedar's Accounting & Advisor Implementation
Accounting Logic: Uses an atomic ledger posting service that validates draft status, nonempty lines, and equal debit/credit totals before finalizing journal lines. Outstanding balances are dynamically derived from payment allocations.
Advisor Architecture: Fully deterministic. Financial trends and risk levels are computed directly by Django rules.
AI Provider Role: Groq is used optionally for narration only. It receives pre-calculated Django outputs to write explanations. If Groq fails or credentials are missing, the system defaults to deterministic explanatory text without altering financial numbers.
Verification Limits

The review verified the source code structure via static inspection. It explicitly did not execute live runtime tests, authenticated accounting workflows, concurrent posting, or Groq API behavior.
